title: Login page returns HTTP 500 after session timeout
symptoms: Users receive 'Internal Server Error' after being idle for 30+ minutes
Browser console shows 401 unauthorized on refresh
Session cookie appears to be present but invalid
possible_causes: Expired JWT token not handled correctly by frontend
Session store not cleared after logout
Redis cache eviction policy removing active sessions
resolution_steps: Ask user to clear browser cookies and try again
Verify Redis session store is not full (check memory usage)
Restart auth-service pod if issue persists
Check auth-service logs for token validation errors
If recurring, escalate to Customer Web Team

title: Slow page load times during peak hours
symptoms: Dashboard takes 15-20 seconds to load between 9 AM - 11 AM
API response times exceed 5 seconds
Users report timeouts on profile page
possible_causes: Database connection pool exhaustion
Missing database indexes on user_profile table
Cache hit rate drops during high traffic
CDN not configured for static assets
resolution_steps: Check database connection pool metrics in Grafana
Add indexes on frequently queried columns (user_id, created_at)
Increase Redis cache size if memory allows
Enable CDN caching for static assets
Consider implementing query result caching

title: Profile update fails silently without error message
symptoms: User clicks 'Save' but nothing happens
No error message displayed to user
Network tab shows 400 Bad Request response
Changes are not persisted in database
possible_causes: Frontend validation not matching backend schema
API endpoint expecting different field format
CSRF token mismatch
Missing required fields not caught by frontend validation
resolution_steps: Check browser console for JavaScript errors
Verify API request payload matches expected schema
Ensure CSRF token is included in request headers
Add proper error handling in frontend code
Display user-friendly error messages

title: Payment service timeout during high transaction volume
symptoms: Payment confirmation page hangs indefinitely
Users receive 'Request Timeout' after 30 seconds
Payment may or may not be processed (inconsistent state)
Error rate spikes in payment-service logs
possible_causes: Payment gateway API response time degradation
Insufficient worker processes to handle concurrent requests
Database lock contention on transaction table
Network latency to external payment provider
resolution_steps: Check payment gateway status page for outages
Scale up payment-service workers temporarily
Implement idempotency keys to prevent duplicate charges
Add circuit breaker pattern for payment gateway calls
Review database query performance on transaction inserts
Contact payment provider if issue persists

title: User profile service returns stale data after update
symptoms: User updates profile information but sees old data on refresh
Changes take 5-10 minutes to appear
Different microservices show different versions of user data
possible_causes: Cache invalidation not triggered after update
Multiple cache layers with different TTLs
Event bus message not propagating to all consumers
CDN edge caching user-specific data
resolution_steps: Manually invalidate cache for affected user
Check event bus logs for message delivery failures
Review cache invalidation logic in user-profile-service
Ensure cache-control headers prevent user data caching
Consider implementing cache versioning strategy

title: Search service returns incomplete results
symptoms: Newly added products don't appear in search for 1-2 hours
Search results missing items that exist in database
Some users report seeing results, others don't
possible_causes: Elasticsearch index not syncing properly
Product indexing job failing silently
Index sharding causing routing issues
Replication lag in Elasticsearch cluster
resolution_steps: Check Elasticsearch cluster health status
Verify indexing job logs for errors
Manually reindex affected products
Review index mapping configuration
Check network connectivity between app and ES cluster
Consider increasing index refresh interval

title: Notification service sending duplicate emails
symptoms: Users receive 2-3 copies of the same notification email
Duplicates arrive within seconds of each other
Issue occurs intermittently, not for all notifications
possible_causes: Message queue consumer processing message multiple times
Idempotency check not working correctly
Retry logic triggering before original request completes
Database unique constraint not enforced
resolution_steps: Add idempotency key to notification requests
Implement deduplication logic in consumer
Check message queue visibility timeout settings
Add unique constraint on notification_id in database
Review retry policy configuration

title: Report generation fails for large date ranges
symptoms: Report export times out after 60 seconds
Success for date ranges < 30 days, fails for > 30 days
Memory usage spikes during report generation
Worker process crashes without error message
possible_causes: Loading entire dataset into memory at once
No pagination in database query
Insufficient worker memory allocation
Inefficient data processing algorithm
resolution_steps: Implement cursor-based pagination for large datasets
Process data in batches instead of all at once
Increase worker memory limits
Add background job for large reports with email notification
Optimize database query with proper indexes
Consider pre-aggregating common report metrics

title: API gateway returns 502 Bad Gateway intermittently
symptoms: Random 502 errors during normal operation
Issue occurs 1-2 times per hour
Retry immediately usually succeeds
No pattern to timing or specific endpoints
possible_causes: Upstream service health check failing
Network packet loss between gateway and services
Service pods restarting during deployment
Load balancer connection pool exhaustion
resolution_steps: Check upstream service logs for errors or restarts
Review network metrics for packet loss
Verify health check configuration is appropriate
Increase connection timeout settings
Implement retry logic with exponential backoff
Check Kubernetes events for pod evictions

title: Mobile app crashes on iOS when uploading profile picture
symptoms: App crashes immediately after selecting photo from gallery
Issue only affects iOS 17+ devices
Android version works fine
Crash log shows memory warning before crash
possible_causes: Image not being compressed before upload
Memory leak in image processing library
iOS permission handling not properly implemented
Large image files exceeding memory limits
resolution_steps: Implement image compression before upload
Add memory usage monitoring
Request proper iOS photo library permissions
Limit max upload size to 5MB
Update image processing library to latest version
Test with various image formats and sizes
